name: RoboReward
summary: 面向机器人任务进度与成功判断的真实回放数据集和奖励模型基准。
summaryEn: A real robot-rollout dataset and reward-model benchmark for task progress and success assessment.
scaleZh: 54,135 个样本，其中 45,072 个训练样本
licenseZh: 见 Hugging Face 数据条款
access: Dataset available on Hugging Face; benchmark available through HELM
accessZh: 数据集已在 Hugging Face 提供，基准可通过 HELM 访问
verdict: 以成功、近失和失败回放诊断机器人过程状态的基准
verdictEn: A benchmark diagnosing robot process state from success, near-miss, and failure rollouts
wmNote: 回放级进度分数可用于世界模型结果预测和价值估计。
wmNoteEn: Rollout-level progress scores support world-model outcome prediction and value estimation.
